title: The Village That Gave Up
status: source gameplay revision implemented; current validation and live-client acceptance recorded in the source review

actors.name: Ken-Ken
actors.greeting: Too many sads here. Ken-Ken has medicine, but medicine needs brave hands.

actors.name: Yi-Mo Longbrow
actors.greeting: I left everything behind. Even the thought of going home feels heavy.

actors.name: Kang Bramblestaff
actors.greeting: Bring me fresh marsh leaves. We will begin with something warm.

actors.name: Maruut Stonebinder
actors.greeting: A damaged ward can draw fear into itself. We must find where this one is broken.

actors.name: Iain Firebeard
actors.greeting: Any friend who stands by a family in hardship has a place at our gathering.

actors.name: Village Provisioner
actors.greeting: I count the sacks every morning. Then I sit down, and none of it seems to matter.

actors.name: Village Herbalist
actors.greeting: The herbs are drying on their racks. I know what each one is for. I cannot make myself reach for them.

actors.name: Village Toolkeeper
actors.greeting: Yi-Mo left his tools here. I should have followed him. I should have done something.

actors.name: Village Cook
actors.greeting: The hearth is cold. Yesterday I meant to light it. Perhaps yesterday was longer ago than I remember.

actors.name: Village Laborer
actors.greeting: There are beams to mend and paths to clear. Every task feels heavier than the last.

actors.name: Village Wardkeeper
actors.greeting: The ward used to quiet the well. Now I hear it even when I close my eyes.

actors.name: Village Tailor
actors.greeting: They need blankets before the rain. The needle is still where I left it.

actors.name: Village Scout
actors.greeting: I have walked these paths for years. Lately I cannot bear to look beyond the next bend.

items.name: Damaged Ward Rubbing
items.description: The broken rune turns the village's fear toward its old well.

items.name: Village Food Supplies
items.description: Sound provisions recovered from the village stores.

items.name: Prepared Herbal Medicine
items.description: Kang has warmed the gathered herbs for Ken-Ken's treatment.

items.name: Ken-Ken's Treatment Mask
items.description: Use on the next patient Ken-Ken names. Defeat the despair it releases.

items.name: Despair Residue Sample
items.description: The same dark residue was drawn from three afflicted residents.

items.description: Maruut asks Iain Firebeard to receive a trusted traveler of either faction.

quests.title: Ken-Ken
quests.objectives: Find Ken-Ken and inspect the village together.
quests.description: Kang's letter brought you to our relief station. The families here have food and shelter, but they have stopped caring for themselves. Ken-Ken is helping at the southern camp. Ask him to show you what has happened.
quests.completion: These people are sick with something food alone will not mend.
quests.request_text: Did Ken-Ken show you what has happened to the families?
quests.return_text: Speak with Ken-Ken at the village relief camp.

quests.title: What's Eating the Village?
quests.objectives: Question the three despondent residents about what is wrong with the village.
quests.description: Speak to the provisioner, herbalist and cooking keeper here in the village. They have stopped tending their work and their neighbors. Find out why. We need to understand this despair before Ken-Ken can try to treat it.
quests.completion: Their stories share the same emptiness. We must find Yi-Mo.
quests.request_text: Have you checked the food and heard all three residents' troubles?
quests.return_text: Speak with Ken-Ken at the village relief camp.

quests.title: Finding Yi-Mo
quests.objectives: Find Yi-Mo on the marsh trail east of the village.
quests.description: Yi-Mo has wandered out toward the eastern marsh trail, where predators hunt. Find him and speak to him. Finding him is the first task; bringing him home comes next.
quests.completion: You came all that way for me? I cannot understand it yet.
quests.request_text: Have you completed the work I asked you to do?
quests.return_text: Speak with Yi-Mo Longbrow at the village relief camp.

quests.title: Cheer Up, Yi-Mo
quests.objectives: Speak to Yi-Mo and bring him back to the village.
quests.description: Yi-Mo will not come home on his own. Speak to him on the trail and insist that he stand up. Stay with him, clear the predators along the way, and bring him back to the village. His neighbors are waiting for him.
quests.completion: He has returned. Now we can begin treating the village together.
quests.request_text: Have you completed the work I asked you to do?
quests.return_text: Speak with Ken-Ken at the village relief camp.

quests.title: Materia Medica
quests.objectives: Gather 4 chunks of honeycomb, 4 mudfish and 4 salty cores for Ken-Ken's remedy.
quests.description: Ken-Ken's first theory needs three ingredients. Gather honeycomb from the small hives along the village's eastern edge, take four mudfish from the provisioner's fishing hamper, and defeat the weeping marsh horrors southeast of camp for four salty cores. Bring all three ingredients back to Ken-Ken.
quests.completion: The medicine is ready. Ken-Ken's mask will carry it into the curse.
quests.request_text: Have you completed the work I asked you to do?
quests.return_text: Speak with Kang Bramblestaff at the village cooking hearth.

quests.title: Why So Serious?
quests.objectives: Collect 18 panther fangs and the jar of pigment from the eastern marsh.
quests.description: The first remedy did not remove the village's despair. Ken-Ken remembers a mask used to confront it. Kill marsh panthers for eighteen fangs and retrieve the pigment jar at the edge of their hunting ground. Bring the materials here so he can prepare the mask; you will use it on the wardens in the next quest.
quests.completion: This residue came from every resident. It is the same influence.
quests.request_text: Have you completed the work I asked you to do?
quests.return_text: Speak with Ken-Ken at the village relief camp.

quests.title: Apply Directly to the Forehead
quests.objectives: Treat 8 villagers with the mask and defeat the released lesser manifestations.
quests.description: There are eight people still trapped in this gloom. Use the mask on the next untreated villager, then defeat the despair it releases. Work through the round in the order Ken-Ken shows you. You can ask him to resume whenever you need.
quests.completion: Eight people can breathe freely again. Yi-Mo is still struggling.
quests.request_text: Eight villagers need help. Have you defeated the despair released from every patient?
quests.return_text: Speak with Ken-Ken at the village relief camp.

quests.title: The Well Beneath the Ward
quests.objectives: Take a sample of the tainted water collected beside the old village well.
quests.description: The villagers draw their water from the old well southeast of camp. Take a sample from the water sack beside it and bring it here. The treatment has helped the people; now we must find the source of the remaining gloom.
quests.completion: The ward has been pulling despair toward the well instead of dispersing it.
quests.request_text: Inspect the well first, then bring me the ward rubbing.
quests.return_text: Speak with Maruut Stonebinder at the village relief camp.

quests.title: Zhu's Despair
quests.objectives: Defeat 8 lesser manifestations, treat Yi-Mo, then defeat the Quintessence of Despair with Ken-Ken's help.
quests.description: Meet Ken-Ken at the old village well. Defeat the eight lesser manifestations that gather there, then use the mask on Yi-Mo. That will draw out the Quintessence of Despair. Defeat it with Ken-Ken's help and keep Yi-Mo alive.
quests.completion: You saved me twice. My thoughts are my own again. We will repair what we neglected.
quests.request_text: Clear the eight lesser manifestations, treat me with the mask, and face what it releases.
quests.return_text: Speak with Yi-Mo Longbrow at the village relief camp.

quests.title: Hands Back to Work
quests.objectives: Relight 3 hearths and help 3 recovered villagers restart the village services.
quests.description: The curse is broken; now we rebuild. Light the three marked household hearths and help the first three residents resume their food, medicine and equipment services. Each family needs a different hand.
quests.completion: Warm hearths, fresh medicine and working hands. The village has begun again.
quests.request_text: Are the three hearths lit and the first three services working again?
quests.return_text: Speak with Mei Barrelbottom at the relief station on the Mudsprocket road.

quests.title: When You Need Us
quests.objectives: Accept the village's pledge of aid and nominate Mei as its future supply liaison.
quests.description: You stayed when we could not help ourselves. Let me put the village's promise in writing. Ask Mei to become our supply liaison, then return to me to accept our pledge.
quests.completion: When you need seeds, supplies or defenders, remember that this village owes you aid.
quests.request_text: Have you accepted our pledge and asked Mei to keep our supply route open?
quests.return_text: Speak with Yi-Mo Longbrow at the village relief camp.

quests.title: The Families in the Hills
quests.objectives: Deliver the Wildhammer introduction letter to Iain at the neutral Hinterlands gathering.
quests.description: The ward rubbing points toward the hills of the Eastern Kingdoms. Iain Firebeard has agreed to receive travelers from both factions at a neutral gathering outside Aerie Peak. Carry this letter to him in the western Hinterlands; you need not enter Aerie Peak itself.
quests.completion: Maruut's friends are welcome here. Rest at our table before we speak of the families.
quests.request_text: Do you carry Maruut's letter? There is room at our table.
quests.return_text: Speak with Iain Firebeard at the neutral gathering outside Aerie Peak in the Hinterlands.
